cohort: 32 children with autism and 14 children without autism (control group)
finding: Higher birth order, higher parental education, excessive TV watching, inadequate opportunity to socialize with peers, and inadequate interactive relationships with family members were significantly associated with autism.
mod_finding: 53.1% of children with autism and 57.1% in the normal speech delay group were born by cesarean sections.
gest_age: Full-term (96.9% in autism group, 92.9% in control group)
followup_time: Mean age 3.75 years in autism group and 2.83 years in control group
